What happens to my Google / Gmail when I die?

Short answer: Google never hands over passwords. If you set up Inactive Account Manager, up to 10 people you chose can download the data you picked once your account goes inactive. Without it, immediate family or a representative can ask Google to close the account, release funds or provide some data, decided case by case.

Key facts

  • Passwords: never shared
  • Plan ahead: Inactive Account Manager, up to 10 contacts
  • No plan: deceased-user request (close, funds or data)
  • Inactivity: personal accounts can be deleted after 2 years

How do I prepare my Google / Gmail account?

  1. Open myaccount.google.com → Data & privacy → 'Make a plan for your digital legacy' (Inactive Account Manager).
  2. Choose a wait period, add up to 10 trusted contacts, and pick which data each one can download.
  3. Optionally set an auto-reply and choose whether to delete the account afterwards.
  4. For a loved one who has died: use Google's deceased-user request form to ask for closure, funds or data.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Your ID and the deceased person's Gmail address
  • A death certificate
  • For data requests, Google may ask for further legal documents such as a court order

How long does it take?

Inactive Account Manager runs only after the inactivity period you set. Deceased-user requests are reviewed individually and Google gives no fixed timeframe.

What can't be recovered?

  • Passwords and login access
  • Account contents after a closure request: Google says it can't process a later request for the contents once you choose to close the account
  • Everything, if the account is deleted under the 2-year inactivity policy

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Google / Gmail when I die?

Google never hands over passwords. If you set up Inactive Account Manager, up to 10 people you chose can download the data you picked once your account goes inactive. Without it, immediate family or a representative can ask Google to close the account, release funds or provide some data, decided case by case.

Can my family log into my Gmail after I die?

Not with Google's blessing. Google doesn't share passwords. Use Inactive Account Manager so contacts can download data instead.

Does Google delete inactive accounts?

Google's policy lets it delete personal accounts that have been inactive for 2 years.

Should I request data or closure first?

Data first. Google says that if you close the account it can't later turn over its contents.

Does Inactive Account Manager include YouTube?

Yes. Google's own example lists Blogger, Drive, Mail and YouTube among the data a contact can be given.
